trust.description: Reading problems is supported; compiling and running requires a trusted workspace.
setting.cfide.ui.language: CFIDE interface language. Does not translate problem statements or code.
setting.cfide.codeforces.handle: Optional public read-only Codeforces handle for submission results and nearby ranking. No account authentication is performed.
setting.cfide.python.interpreter: Python 3 executable or absolute path. On Windows you may need to set this to python. For virtual environments, use the interpreter's full path.
setting.cfide.python.args: Additional Python interpreter arguments. CFIDE adds unbuffered UTF-8 execution flags.
setting.cfide.python.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a Python template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
setting.cfide.cpp.compiler: C++ compiler executable or absolute path.
setting.cfide.cpp.args: Compiler arguments, passed without a shell.
setting.cfide.cpp.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a C++ template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
